name: Shy Fireant 5
author: elijahgummer
description: Neon gradient indigo toggle switch that glows on hover.
howItWorks:
On hover, transform becomes rotate(135deg), border becomes 1px solid #fff, box-shadow becomes 0 0 2px #ffffff, 0 0 5px #ffffff,
    0 0 20px #ffffff, 0 0 30px #ffffff,
    0 0 40px #ffffff, 0 0 50px #ffffff,
    0 0 60px #ffffff.
